U6KDJdnwBzrqnJZbLUeMvg.zh: WHO於今年5/14召開第45次IHR小兒麻痺症緊急委員會並於8/25公布決議,今年截至4/30全球累積報告16例WPV1病例、2 例cVDPV1病例、28例cVDPV2病例及2例cVDPV3病例。環境樣本部分:累計報告74件WPV1、27件cVDPV2。考量全球疫情傳播及疫苗覆蓋率,評估持續構成國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),並再延⻑臨時性措施3個月,惟不構成緊急大流行(Pandemic Emergency),並建議有11個國家(有WPV1、cVDPV1、cVDPV3傳播風險者)需加強疫情監測及疫苗接種等措施,包括有WPV1疫情之阿富汗、巴基斯坦、德國,有cVDPV1 疫情之阿爾及利亞、剛果⺠主共和國、吉布地、以色列、寮國,有cVDPV3疫情之喀麥隆、查德、奈及利亞;另建議24個有cVDPV2國內傳播風險的國家加強防治措施。由於核疫區的持續傳播、偏鄉與衝突地區疫苗接種覆蓋率不均以及頻繁的跨國人口流動,WPV1及cVDPV仍具有高度國際傳播風險 。 WHO於8/19宣布非洲5國cVDPV2疫情已終止,分別為蒲隆地 、迦納、幾內亞比索、剛果共和國及烏干達。當局近年透過資金與技術支援、加強疫苗接種,強化急性無力肢體麻痺監測與實驗室檢驗能力,以及應用地理資訊系統的成功阻斷疫情。
U6KDJdnwBzrqnJZbLUeMvg.en: WHO convened the 45th IHR Emergency Committee on polio on 14 May this year and published its decision on 25 August. As of 30 April this year, 16 WPV1 cases, 2 cVDPV1 cases, 28 cVDPV2 cases and 2 cVDPV3 cases had been reported worldwide. For environmental samples, 74 WPV1 and 27 cVDPV2 detections had been reported cumulatively. Considering global transmission and vaccination coverage, the committee assessed that polio continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), extended temporary recommendations by 3 months, but does not constitute a Pandemic Emergency. It recommended that 11 countries at risk of WPV1, cVDPV1 or cVDPV3 transmission strengthen surveillance and vaccination: Afghanistan, Pakistan and Germany (WPV1 outbreaks); Algeria, the DRC, Djibouti, Israel and Laos (cVDPV1 outbreaks); and Cameroon, Chad and Nigeria (cVDPV3 outbreaks). It also recommended that 24 countries at risk of domestic cVDPV2 transmission strengthen control measures. Owing to continued transmission in endemic areas, uneven vaccination coverage in remote and conflict-affected areas, and frequent cross-border population movement, WPV1 and cVDPV remain at high risk of international spread. WHO declared on 19 August that cVDPV2 outbreaks had ended in five African countries: Burundi, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, the Republic of the Congo and Uganda. In recent years, these outbreaks were stopped through financial and technical support, enhanced vaccination, strengthened acute flaccid paralysis surveillance and laboratory capacity, and the use of geographic information systems.

44VM-a8M61mNqd6ddNEdjA.zh: 小兒麻痺症全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於6/18-24期間,cVDPV1 新增2國共3例,分別為寮國2例(前已掌握)、衣索比亞1例;cVDPV2新增中非共和國/馬利各1例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV2新增奈及利亞1件。
44VM-a8M61mNqd6ddNEdjA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for the period 18–24 June: cVDPV1 cases increased by 3 across 2 countries, with 2 in Laos (previously identified) and 1 in Ethiopia; cVDPV2 cases increased by 1 each in the Central African Republic and Mali; and for environmental samples, cVDPV2 increased by 1 in Nigeria.

Afe9_Rviq5y1twRiHzmHSA.zh: 寮國沙灣拿吉省(Savannakhet)於12/12確診1例cVDPV1病例,為3歲個案,於9/3出現急性肢體無力症狀,並在其病毒檢體中發現31個基因突變點,推估已在該國傳播大約3年,另有2例相關病例檢測中;因本案鄰近越南邊界且往來密切,WHO評估越南面臨極高輸入及再出現病例風險,該國已召開全國緊急會議並加強監測。 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於12/4-10期間,cVDPV2新增3國共4例,分別為安哥拉2例、奈及利亞/葉門各1例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV2新增索馬利亞2件。
Afe9_Rviq5y1twRiHzmHSA.en: Savannakhet province in Laos confirmed one cVDPV1 case on 12 December, in a 3-year-old child who developed acute limb weakness on 3 September. The viral sample showed 31 genetic mutation sites, and the virus is estimated to have circulated in the country for about three years; two related cases are being tested. Because this case is near the Viet Nam border with close cross-border movement, WHO assesses that Viet Nam faces a very high risk of importation and re-emergence of cases. The country has convened a national emergency meeting and strengthened surveillance. The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for 4–10 December that cVDPV2 added 4 cases in 3 countries: 2 in Angola, and 1 each in Nigeria and Yemen. For environmental samples, cVDPV2 added 2 samples in Somalia.

I7lgLIhArwtC_eWrU2ch1Q.zh: 印度疫情更新,今年10月報告22,659例病例,較9月18,803例病例增加21%。今年截至10/31已累計91,015例病例,低於去年同期184,712例病例,去年全年共報告232,425例。 寮國疫情更新,今年1-11月累計11,629例病例及1例死亡,主要分布於永珍5,520例病例及1例死亡,該國去年報告逾20,000例病例及11例死亡。 美國佛羅里達州邁阿密-戴德郡近1週新增2例本土病例,該州今年迄今累計60例本土病例,主要分布於布里瓦德郡、希爾斯波羅郡、邁阿密-戴德郡及帕斯科郡,主要檢出型別為DENV-3;該州去年報告91例病例,2023年報告186例病例。
I7lgLIhArwtC_eWrU2ch1Q.en: India update: 22,659 cases were reported in October this year, a 21% increase over 18,803 cases in September. Cumulatively this year to 31 October, 91,015 cases have been reported, lower than the 184,712 cases in the same period last year; 232,425 cases were reported in the whole of last year. Laos update: 11,629 cases and 1 death were reported cumulatively in January–November this year, mainly in Vientiane Capital, with 5,520 cases and 1 death. The country reported more than 20,000 cases and 11 deaths last year. In Miami-Dade County, Florida, 2 new local cases were reported in the past week. The state has recorded 60 locally acquired cases so far this year, mainly in Broward, Hillsborough, Miami-Dade and Pasco counties, with DENV-3 the main serotype detected. The state reported 91 cases last year and 186 cases in 2023.

R3OmGmQ_EGdjsAohMelCTA.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第31週(7/28-8/3)全球陽性率6.06%,創今年新高,美洲、歐洲、東南亞區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情於低點小幅度反彈,第33週(8/11-17)定醫門急診陽性率上升至11.9%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高;香港疫情小幅反彈,第33週陽性率上升至1.5%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(54%),另XFG占0.3%。 西太平洋區署第31週疫情更新,日本陽性率上升至43%,韓國陽性率上升至23%,其他國家如新加坡、印、寮國、澳洲及紐西蘭等陽性率皆下降。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,美洲、歐洲、東南亞區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株由XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1及LP.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
R3OmGmQ_EGdjsAohMelCTA.en: Epidemiological update: in week 31 of 2025 (28 July–3 August), global test positivity was 6.06%, the highest this year, with increases in the Americas, Europe and South-East Asia regions. China's outbreak has rebounded slightly from a low: sentinel outpatient and emergency positivity rose to 11.9% in week 33 (11–17 August), with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Hong Kong's outbreak rebounded slightly: positivity rose to 1.5% in week 33, with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant (54%) and XFG at 0.3%. In the Western Pacific Region's week 31 update, positivity rose to 43% in Japan and 23% in South Korea, while positivity fell in other countries including Singapore, India, Lao PDR, Australia and New Zealand. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, with the Americas, Europe and South-East Asia regions rising. The predominant global variant is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1 and LP.8.1. WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.
